messages:
yara: rolling onboard of titan-22b-int4v2 with extended-window=64k. quick smoke ok but long-prefill goldset shows token drift starting ~49190. opening thread to centralize notes.

pete: can you paste the invocation and the key log lines?

yara: cmd:
```bash
./onboard.sh --model=titan-22b-int4v2 --prefill=50000 --quant=int4v2 --trace=kv,rotary
```
log snippet:
```
kv.write req=49192 stored=49192
kv.write req=49205 stored=16377
kv.read  req=49205 served=16377
rotary.apply pos=49205 used=16377
```

marta: stored=16377 smells like a 15/14-bit mask or old page-sized LUT. similar to other reports but new model and kernel path. check for uint16_t casts in shard math + any POS_MASK constants.

hugo: quick hypothesis: int4 fast path precomputes rotary LUT into circular buffer sized 16k for perf; not gated for extended-window builds. float path computes on the fly so unaffected.

yara: noted. mitigation: enable `kv.safe-evict` on canary pool to avoid writing high indices until we patch. will also enable `kv.index.trace` to dump last 128 writes.

pete: plan: 1) audit for small-index typedefs + POS_MASKs (i'll grep), 2) add dev-assert and trace, 3) widen kernel buffers / lift masks to 32-bit, 4) run float vs int4 diff on longprefill goldset. i'll open PRs and link here.

ci-bot: CI triggered: titan-int4v2/patch-3287654321. Unit tests: kv-index, rotary-lut, long-prefill-smoke.

yara: thanks. leaving traces enabled for next 6 runs. if anyone reproduces with a different seed or sees wrap vs clamp call it out. :thumbsup:
